name: GetStarted
title: Templates/Platform/Detail/GetStarted
summary: The onboarding block for a resource made from the CLI: a section heading with a toggle between the CLI and GitHub Actions paths, then three numbered step cards, each with a code block for its commands. It sits under the summary on a resource Overview tab and at the end of a create wizard, on the deploy success screen. Built from `SegmentedButton`, `CardBox` and `CodeBlock`.

variants.name: Ci
variants.summary: The GitHub Actions path: store a personal token as a repository secret, add the deploy workflow, then push to the production branch.
